Decision to make

You support a multi-agent service desk. Classify five fields into context, knowledge or aggregate audit data.

Core concept

Temporary context, approved knowledge and audit records have different access and retention needs. Storing everything increases exposure and retains stale conclusions. Define correction and deletion paths.

Practice contract

Keep rows with a numeric confidence between zero and one. Missing rows must not enter the accepted set.

Evidence and boundary

Show normal, missing and uncertain cases. No real data or external actions.

Review and reflect

An outcome count without message text
